headline: Monday's three pre-registered studies are closed on the numbers: momentum side filter, size-based stop width and dip-then-turn mornings show no edge at the bar. Each closure states the smallest effect it could have seen.
bullets: MOMSIDE (skip trades against 12-month momentum): t 0.96 vs bar 2.91; all of it is one up-market cell, and the forward window reverses (-723R). Nothing above 0.025R per skipped trade.
SIZESTOP (wider stops on big-gap days): no better than widening on random days; nothing above 0.004R per changed trade. Gross-R check asked: the small net gain may just be lower cents-per-R costs.
DIPTURN (owner's dip-then-turn morning, anchored at 09:50): long setups +0.009R/trade, t 0.92 vs 3.57; mirror for shorts negative. Nothing above ~0.045R.
